title: The oven
alt: A cook in white kitchen whites and a white cap stands at a tiled wood-fired oven with a fire burning inside it, stacked pizza boxes to his left.
caption: Shot from across the room at f/6.3. The fire in the mouth of the oven is doing almost all of the work here — everything above the counter falls away into the dark, and the tiled dome only reads because it is white.

title: Paper umbrella
alt: A black and white striped paper straw and a small red paper cocktail umbrella resting on the rim of a frosted glass, with the restaurant behind them thrown out of focus.
caption: A paper umbrella is a small piece of theatre, and small pieces of theatre deserve portraits. Focus on the frost of the glass and let the rest of the restaurant dissolve behind it.

title: Penne and garlic bread
alt: Overhead view of penne in a white sauce with red pepper, olives and courgette, a slice of garlic bread beside it on a white plate, on a dark wood table.
caption: Overhead, because it is the only angle from which a plate reads as a plate. The garlic bread negotiated its own corner of the frame.

title: Pizza from above
alt: A whole pizza on a wooden board seen from above, topped with red pepper, jalapenos, red onion and torn mozzarella, with a drink and its paper umbrella at the edge of the frame.
caption: Two frames of the same table, six minutes apart. The drink is still in the corner, still wearing its paper umbrella, still declining to get out of the way.
